title: Cloud SQL `stopReplay` Method Breaking Change
summary: The `workloadCaptures.stopReplay` method has undergone a breaking change, removing the `workloadId` parameter from its URI path and altering the `StopWorkloadReplayContext` schema. This is a significant adjustment to the recently introduced workload replay functionality.
details: Developers using the Cloud SQL Admin API should update their calls to `workloadCaptures.stopReplay`. The `workloadId` path parameter has been removed, changing the URI template from `sql/v1beta4/projects/{project}/instances/{instance}/workloadCaptures/{workloadId}:stopReplay` to `sql/v1beta4/projects/{project}/instances/{instance}/workloadCaptures:stopReplay`. This effectively rolls back the requirement for `workloadId` in the path, which was previously made strictly required in the September 16th update. Additionally, the `StopWorkloadReplayContext` schema no longer includes the `replayInstance` and `workloadId` properties.
